Name: Pet Crow
Author: monteso
Description:
WARNING: DO NOT DOWNLOAD THIS MOD ANY OTHER PLACE THAN NEXUSMODS. WWW.STARDEWVALLEYMODS.NET STEALS MY AND OTHER PEOPLE'S MODS AND UPLOADS THEM ON THEIR WEBSITE WITHOUT PERMISSION. DON'T DOWNLOAD OUR MODS THERE


What else can I say, that the title hasn't already. This mod replaces the cat you get from Marnie with a crow.

Digging through the game files, you can find alot of sprite sheets that are either outdated or where never made part of the finished game. One sheet I found was for, I assume, a crow entity that you could see in the world eating your crops. So i decide that I just had to use this somewhere, and that it would make for an awesome pet. Everybody has already done every breed of cat and dog re-textures, so why not this.

Note: The crow will still make a cat's meow when interacted with. To change that would require editing the sound file, and that is something I don't want to tackle. Its out of my skill set, don't have the time to learn, and frankly just not as fun as working with pixel art. Sorry

To install: Open the .rar file, Place my cat.xnb into Stardew Valley/Content/Animals, overwrite when asked. Done
